title: USDC from Polygon to Stellar
meta.title: USDC from Polygon to Stellar: Circle CCTP, no added fees
lede: You burn USDC on Polygon and receive the same amount on Stellar through Circle's CCTP. What arrives is USDC issued by Circle itself. Your wallets sign the transactions; the page only builds them and submits them to the network.
needs.title: Requirements
needs.usdc: USDC on Polygon in MetaMask, plus a few cents of POL for gas: two transactions
needs.trustline: A Stellar account with a USDC trustline: the USDC will arrive there
needs.xlm: Albedo or Freighter with a Stellar account that has a little XLM above the reserve, the fee is about 0.03 XLM per transfer: it signs and sends the final transaction, the contract call. Usually the same account as the recipient, but any account will do
step1.title: From and to
step1.toHint: Connect the wallet that will receive the USDC. It must already hold a USDC trustline.
step1.noMemo: No memo: CCTP does not support it.
step1.amountHint: Try 1 USDC first and make sure it arrives on Stellar.
step2.title: Burn on Polygon
step2.text: Two confirmations in MetaMask: approve USDC for the CCTP contract, then the burn itself. The approval is skipped when an earlier one still covers the amount.
step3.title: Receive on Stellar
step3.resume: Burned earlier and did not finish? Paste the burn hash here: the recipient and the amount are inside Circle's message.
step3.signer: Stellar account that submits the transaction
step3.signerHint: Usually this is the recipient's own wallet. Any other Stellar account can submit it instead: the submitter only pays the network fee in XLM, the USDC still go to the recipient from the message.
step3.signerKnown: The transaction will be submitted by {address} ({wallet}).
contracts.title: Contracts this page talks to
contracts.note: Compare them with the addresses Circle publishes before signing anything.

meta.titleReverse: USDC from Stellar to Polygon: Circle CCTP, no added fees
ledeReverse: You burn USDC on Stellar and receive the same amount on Polygon through Circle's CCTP. What arrives is native USDC issued by Circle. Your wallets sign the transactions; the page only builds them and submits them to the network.
needsR.usdc: USDC on Stellar in Albedo or Freighter, plus a little XLM above the reserve for the fees: two transactions, about 0.03 XLM each
needsR.evm: A Polygon address in MetaMask: the USDC will arrive there. No trustline or approval needed
needsR.pol: A few cents of POL on that MetaMask account: receiving is a Polygon transaction, and its gas is paid by whoever sends it
r1.toHint: Connect the MetaMask account that will receive the USDC.
r1.noMemo: Only an address you control: CCTP carries no memo or tag, so an exchange deposit address may lose the funds.
r1.amountHint: Try 1 USDC first and make sure it arrives on Polygon.
r2.title: Burn on Stellar
r2.text: Two signatures in your Stellar wallet: allow Circle's contract to take the USDC, then the burn itself. The approval is skipped when an earlier one still covers the amount. Each transaction is valid for 10 minutes after it is built.
r3.title: Receive on Polygon
r3.resume: Burned earlier and did not finish? Paste the Stellar transaction hash here: the recipient and the amount are inside Circle's message.
